insert all into FX_IMIX_MEM_INFO ( SEQNO, JYCYID, JGDM, JYCYQC, ZWJC, YWQC, YWJC, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME,ZWJCSZM )
select SEQNO, JYCYID, JGDM, JYCYQC, ZWJC, YWQC, YWJC, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME,ZWJCSZM from
select #{items.id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as SEQNO, #{items.jycyid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as JYCYID, #{items.jgdm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as JGDM, #{items.jycyqc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as JYCYQC, #{items.zwjc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as ZWJC , #{items.ywqc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as YWQC, #{items.ywjc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as YWJC , 'BATCH' as CREATORID , SYSDATE as CREATEDTIME, decode(#{items.zwjc,jdbcType=VARCHAR},null,null,(select upper(F_TRANS_PINYIN_CAPITAL(#{items.zwjc,jdbcType=VARCHAR})) as XM from dual)) AS ZWJCSZM from dual

insert all into FX_IMIX_MEM_MAIL_INFO ( SEQNO, JYCYID, JYCY, JYYID, JYYXM, LXDH, CZ, EMAIL, MSN, TXDZ, YZBM, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME,JYYXMSZM )
SELECT SEQNO, JYCYID, JYCY, JYYID, JYYXM, LXDH, CZ, EMAIL, MSN, TXDZ, YZBM, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME, JYYXMSZM FROM
Select #{items.id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS SEQNO, #{items.jycyid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JYCYID, #{items.jycy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JYCY, #{items.jyyid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JYYID, #{items.jyyxm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JYYXM, #{items.lxdh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS LXDH, #{items.cz,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CZ, #{items.email,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS EMAIL, #{items.msn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS MSN, #{items.txdz,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TXDZ, #{items.yzbm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS YZBM, 'BATCH' AS CREATORID, SYSDATE AS CREATEDTIME, decode(#{items.jyyxm,jdbcType=VARCHAR},null,null,(select upper(F_TRANS_PINYIN_CAPITAL(#{items.jyyxm,jdbcType=VARCHAR})) as XM from dual)) AS JYYXMSZM from dual

insert all into FX_IMIX_ERROR_INFO ( SEQNO, MARKETINDICATOR, APPLERRORCODE, APPLERRORDESC, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME, LASTMODIFIERID, LASTMODIFIEDTIME )
SELECT SEQNO, MARKETINDICATOR, APPLERRORCODE, APPLERRORDESC, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME, LASTMODIFIERID, LASTMODIFIEDTIME FROM
Select #{items.id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS SEQNO, #{items.marketindicator,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS MARKETINDICATOR, #{items.applerrorcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS APPLERRORCODE, #{items.applerrordesc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS APPLERRORDESC, 'BATCH' AS CREATORID, SYSDATE AS CREATEDTIME, 'BATCH' AS LASTMODIFIERID, SYSDATE AS LASTMODIFIEDTIME from dual

insert all into FX_IMIX_BOND_INFO ( SEQNO, SECID, SPECIALDEBT, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME )
select SEQNO, SECID, SPECIALDEBT, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME from
select #{items.seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as SEQNO, #{items.secid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as SECID, #{items.specialdebt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as SPECIALDEBT, 'BATCH' as CREATORID, SYSDATE as CREATEDTIME from dual

insert all into FX_imix_JGZCGX ( SEQNO, ZJGMC, ZJGLWM, CJGMC, CJGLWM, ZGXLXMC, CGXLXMC, EFFECTFLAG, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME
)
select SEQNO, ZJGMC, ZJGLWM, CJGMC, CJGLWM, ZGXLXMC, CGXLXMC, EFFECTFLAG, CREATORID, CREATEDTIME from
select #{items.seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as SEQNO, #{items.zjgmc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as ZJGMC, #{items.zjglwm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as ZJGLWM, #{items.cjgmc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as CJGMC, #{items.cjglwm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as CJGLWM, #{items.zgxlxmc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as ZGXLXMC, #{items.cgxlxmc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as CGXLXMC, 'E' as EFFECTFLAG, 'BATCH' as CREATORID, SYSDATE as CREATEDTIME from dual
mapper.update: begin for aa in (select temp.* from (select m.rowid rowidm, m.*, n.seqno nseqno, 'Y' flag, null bjgdm, null bzwjc from FX_IMIX_MEM_MAIL_INFO m left join FX_imix_JGZCGX n on m.jycyid = n.zjglwm union all select m.rowid rowidm, m.*, n.seqno nseqno, 'N' flag, (select distinct y.jgdm from FX_IMIX_MEM_INFO y where y.jycyid = (select distinct x.zjglwm from FX_imix_JGZCGX x where x.cjglwm = m.jycyid)) bjddm, (select distinct y.zwjc from FX_IMIX_MEM_INFO y where y.jycyid = (select distinct x.zjglwm from FX_imix_JGZCGX x where x.cjglwm = m.jycyid)) bzwjc from FX_IMIX_MEM_MAIL_INFO m left join FX_imix_JGZCGX n on m.jycyid = n.cjglwm) temp where temp.nseqno is not null) loop update FX_IMIX_MEM_MAIL_INFO sm set sm.sfzjg = aa.flag, sm.zjgdm = aa.bjgdm, sm.zjgmc = aa.bzwjc where rowid = aa.rowidm; end loop; end;
